institutions_details.name: Indiana University
institutions_details.campus_description: Indiana University (IU) is a multi-campus public university system in the state of Indiana, United States. It includes campuses like Indiana University Bloomington and Indiana University – Purdue University Indianapolis (IUPUI), and cooperatively manages IPFW.

institutions_details.name: University of Washington
institutions_details.campus_description: The University of Washington is a large, public flagship research university in Seattle, Washington.

comparison_summary: Indiana University is explicitly described as a 'multi-campus public university system' with multiple named campuses (Bloomington, IUPUI, IPFW), while the University of Washington is only mentioned with a single location in Seattle, Washington.
